values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Cabins need 7 nights (Saturday to Saturday) in peak season.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/selkirk-shores-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=82 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'; 'Cabins require a 7-night minimum stay during peak season'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every campsite has electric: 103 at 30 A, 25 at 50 A. No water hookups; no full-hookup sites.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/selkirk-shores-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=82 ('Our campsites do not offer water hook-up, however fresh water fill-up is available at our filling station') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 82 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 103, '50 amp' 25; 'Full Hookup - no' on all 128), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All back-in: 26 at 40 ft, 1 at 34, 44 at 30, 2 at 25, 46 at 20, 7 at 15, 2 with no length. The campsites overlook a bluff on Lake Ontario.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/selkirk-shores-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=82 ('Campsite (128)'; 'campsites overlook a bluff on Lake Ontario') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 82 (Equip length/Driveway '40 Back-In' 26, '34 Back-In' 1, '30 Back-In' 44, '25 Back-In' 2, '20 Back-In' 46, '15 Back-In' 7), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/selkirk-shores-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=82 ('dumping stations, food concessions ... restrooms with showers'; 'fresh water fill-up is available at our filling station'; Services and Amenities: Camp Store, Dump Station), read 2026-10-21

summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season May 14 - Oct 23 with Chipmunk/Dragonfly to Oct 16 (matches), reservable (was inherited; now verified). Added 9-month window, 14-night max, electric on every site (30/50 A), no water hookups, 128 back-in sites to 40 ft, showers, dump, water fill, camp store. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept unchanged.
